description: Implementation of platform-specific MIME type utilities for macOS and iOS, including functions to get MIME types from file extensions and vice versa, using system APIs and conditional compilation.

methods.name: GetPlatformMimeTypeFromExtension
methods.description: Retrieves MIME type for a given file extension using system APIs, with support for macOS 11/iOS 14 and earlier versions.

methods.name: GetPlatformPreferredExtensionForMimeType
methods.description: Retrieves preferred file extension for a given MIME type using system APIs, with support for macOS 11/iOS 14 and earlier versions.

methods.name: GetPlatformExtensionsForMimeType
methods.description: Retrieves all file extensions associated with a MIME type, using system APIs and handling different OS versions.
